qualification_reason: NeJame Law already has mature separate client-journey architecture across its major divisions. The current site has dedicated Personal Injury, Criminal Defense, Immigration and Employment Law hubs, each with service-specific messaging and substantial nested practice content. The firm clearly understands and routinely applies the separate-page concept, so it is outside this campaign ICP.
campaign_notes: Architecture Maturity Gate failed. Although the homepage presents many divisions, those divisions are not trapped in one general page: Personal Injury, Criminal Defense, Immigration and Employment each have focused destinations, with extensive subservice structures. The firm also has a sizeable specialist attorney team. No contact enrichment performed.

service_gap_evidence.service_offered_evidence: Current live pages independently confirm focused Personal Injury, Criminal Defense, Immigration and Employment Law destinations, while the homepage lists extensive nested practice categories.
service_gap_evidence.validation_method: live homepage/domain discovery + dedicated major-practice hubs + architecture-maturity gate
service_gap_evidence.notes: Major client journeys are already separated into focused practice hubs. Not the campaign ICP.
